name: CineVoid | VR Media Player
summary:
CineVoid turns your Meta Quest into a personal cinema for the media you already own.

Browse and stream movies and series from Plex, DLNA/UPnP media servers and Windows or NAS shares over SMB. Watch standard videos on a large adjustable screen, or switch to equirectangular 180° and 360° projection. Side-by-side and top-bottom stereoscopic video are also supported.

Quest-friendly controls provide quick access to seeking, play and pause, screen positioning, projection modes, audio tracks and customizable sub
